description: Connect an output port of one block to an input port of another. Automatically resolves common port aliases (e.g., "in" -> "signal" for uPlotDisplay, "in" -> "error" for PIDController, "+" / "-" for Subtraction).

fromPortId.description: Output port ID of the source block, e.g. "out" (aliases like "signal", "y" are supported)

toPortId.description: Input port ID of the destination block, e.g. "in" (aliases like "signal" or PID "error" are supported)

name: connect_blocks
title: Connect blocks
